items.title: Stella says further McLaren parts are planned for Las Vegas
items.summary: McLaren Team Principal Andrea Stella said parts from the Interlagos package will be complemented by further parts in Las Vegas, forming a foundation for the 2027 car. He named no components; Stella also said cooler conditions helped McLaren in Brazil while hot-weather long-run consistency remains a work in progress.
items.why_it_matters: This is a team development plan, not an FIA submission or a measured performance gain. Las Vegas' FIA event listing remains unavailable, so filing status is unverified.

sources.label: Formula1.com on Stella's McLaren development plan
